concept.label: 01 — Concept
concept.title: An architecture that turns the boundary into a place of encounter.
concept.body: The project explores how in-between spaces can connect landscape, climate and collective life.

program.label: 05 — Programme
program.title: Organising to share
program.body: The programme brings public uses, work spaces and shelter around a shared void.

proposal.label: 06 — The proposal
proposal.title: Building an inhabitable landscape
proposal.body: Plans, sections, elevations and atmospheres will be assembled here as a continuous reading.

material.label: 07 — Materiality
material.title: Matter, light and time
material.body: A restrained material palette lets light and texture define the experience.

model.label: 08 — Physical model
model.title: Thinking with the hands
model.body: This space is ready to document the physical model and its material explorations.

reflection.label: 09 — Final reflection
reflection.quote: The project does not propose an isolated object, but a way of relating to what already exists.
